changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla data_subject_requests: solicitudes de supresión, acceso y rectificación de datos personales. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría data_subject_requests_audit y el trigger data_subject_requests_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Data subject requests (deletion, access, rectification) from users

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: request_type
column.remarks: Request type: deletion, access or rectification

column.name: status
column.remarks: Request status: pending, in_progress, resolved or rejected

column.name: resolved_at
column.remarks: Moment the request was resolved or rejected

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE data_subject_requests ADD CONSTRAINT data_subject_requests_type_ck CHECK (request_type IN ('deletion', 'access', 'rectification'))
ALTER TABLE data_subject_requests ADD CONSTRAINT data_subject_requests_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'rejected'))
CREATE TRIGGER data_subject_requests_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON data_subject_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in data_subject_requests

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE data_subject_requests_audit ADD CONSTRAINT data_subject_requests_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER data_subject_requests_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON data_subject_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS data_subject_requests_audit_trg ON data_subject_requests
